title: Correction to: Citrus yellow vein clearing virus infection triggers phloem remobilization of iron- and zinc-nicotianamine in citrus
content: This is a correction to: Tianchi Jiang, Jiuzhou Chen, Kuan Xu, Bone Sharon, Luxi Li, Jiansheng Guo, Lianghui Liu, Jun Ge, Haizhong Lin, Shengke Tian, Lingli Lu, Citrus yellow vein clearing virus infection triggers phloem remobilization of iron- and zinc-nicotianamine in citrus, Plant Physiology, Volume 197, Issue 2, February 2025, kiae528, https://doi.org/10.1093/plphys/kiae528.
